blurb: Guests rent Polaris RZR off-road vehicles or Polaris Slingshots to explore trails in Southern Arizona including Mount Lemmon, Redington Pass, and the Sonoran Desert. Vehicles come with GPS navigation and a full tank of gas; renters must refill with 91 octane gasoline. Guided and self-guided options are available, including night rides and full moon packages.
extraNote: $1800 refundable deposit hold for off-road RZR vehicles, $850 for Slingshot rentals · Premium insurance required at $40 per vehicle for third party liability · Full refund or credit if cancelled 72 hours before ride; stricter for 3+ vehicles · No refund within 72 hours of reservation; no-shows charged full price · Holiday pricing may apply during Thanksgiving, Christmas, and Spring Break · Vehicle substitution possible for maintenance or safety reasons · Fuel policy: return vehicle with full tank or pay for gas plus $25 surcharge
